title: Naan
desc: Karthik, a boy with psychopathic tendencies, goes to a juvenile home after killing his mother and her lover. After he is released, he steals the identity of a dead man and attends medical school.

title: Ainthampadai
desc: Devasena decides to marry Prabhakaran after she gets a marriage proposal from his family. When she learns that she is chosen to marry his elder brother, she vows to take revenge on him.

title: Vallavan
desc: Vallavan loves Swapna even though she is three years older than him. Although she reciprocates initially, the age difference and his past with a classmate create tensions in their relationship.

title: Red
desc: Red, an orphan who has a heart of gold, grows up to become the local mafia leader of Madurai. Soon, a reporter of a prominent daily publishes his story and makes him a sensation.

title: Arul
desc: Upon taking the blame for his brother's mistake, Arul faces the wrath of his father.
